text:
Alex R.: Heads-up — planning a rollwave tonight 23:00 UTC to bump kernel (v1.4.3 -> v1.5.0) and apply the slim quant profile to prod slices 3-6. Goal: reduce p50 CPU by ~8% without regressing tail latency. Who can own smoke/watch?
Maria C.: I can own EU smoke window (23:00–01:00 UTC). I’ll run the preflight checklist and kv-cache sanity.
Samir: I’ll be deployer. Plan to start slot handoff at 22:45 UTC, kick the rollwave at 23:00. Will do canary 1 slice first, then fanout.
Samir: Quick deploy steps I’ll run:
```bash
# drain slice, apply kernel image, restart runtime
kubectl -n runtime set image ds/engine engine=redwood/engine:v1.5.0
kubectl rollout status ds/engine -w
# apply quant profile
kubectl apply -f slim-quant-prod.yaml
```
Jen L.: Leave canary slice in place for 10m. If p95 latency increases > 20% vs baseline or errors > 0.5% then rollback to v1.4.3. Rollback playbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/rollback-engine (I updated steps 3–5). :white_check_mark:
Leo T.: I’ll run canary perf checks and KV cache sanity. My quick script: `scripts/kv_sanity_check.sh --slice S3` — will post results to thread.
Alex R.: Add alert thresholds: page #eng-oncall if avg latency > 500ms for >=2m or error-rate > 1% for 1m. Also tag any model-facing regression in #product-signal.
Maria C.: Preflight done: node count OK, canary slice S3 reserved, perf baseline collected (attached). No config drift.
Samir: Starting handoff at 22:45 UTC. Tagging @Jen L. and @Leo T. when canary is live.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollwave 1767777777 by Samir. Canary slices: S3. Canary duration: 10m. Rollout strategy: linear fanout (1,2,3,4). Fallback: engine:v1.4.3.
Leo T.: Canary perf at +2% p50, p95 +5% (within threshold). KV sanity: ok. Posting logs: `kv-check: PASS`
Jen L.: Can confirm no functional regressions in quick smoke prompts. Holding for full 10m then approve fanout.
Samir: Fanout step 2 at 23:12 UTC started.
Maria C.: Watching EU; no alerts.
Alex R.: Thanks all. If anyone sees anything odd, call the rollback and ping me. Post a short readback once rollwave completes with final perf delta and any follow-ups. :rocket:
